purpose: Complete the frozen PRJCA046985 native-read Kraken2 workflow and bounded downstream technical/QC summarization without repeated approval prompts.
actions_allowed_without_reapproval: Read GitHub main and etty-handoff state
Validate immutable job definitions, hashes, manifests, checksums, output presence and execution state
Allow ETYY unattended agent to execute already queued authorized jobs
Create bounded zero-download diagnostic jobs for technical execution failures
Create bounded zero-download recovery jobs when scientific parameters, run set, database and analysis semantics remain unchanged
Fix control-plane, environment, path, quoting, version-preflight, observability and idempotency defects without changing scientific semantics
Create read-only technical QC and execution-summary jobs after production completion
Parse already-produced Kraken2 output for technical completion/QC summaries without changing or rerunning the biological method
Create Git commits and normal pushes to origin/main using the accepted freeze-then-queue pattern
Read and validate ETYY handoffs written to etty-handoff
Generate small non-sensitive JSON, TSV, TXT or Markdown reports from already-authorized outputs
do_not_reprompt_for: Retrying or recovering the same frozen 122-run analysis after technical SAFE_STOP
Fixed environment repairs such as PATH LANG LC_ALL
Normal Git commits and pushes required to queue these already-authorized jobs
fresh_approval_required_if: Any new biological sample or run is added
The frozen 122-run production run set changes
A new raw-data download is proposed
threads exceed 4 for this frozen production analysis
a new biological interpretation or new biological analysis method is introduced
resource scope materially expands beyond frozen limits
raw biological data would be committed to Git
legacy ETYY repository state would be modified
